name: Coffee Pub Bibliosoph
tagline: Player messaging, injuries, crits and encounter building.
description: Journal-backed party and private player messaging, authored lasting injuries, critical and fumble card decks, one-use inspiration cards, room searching with loot cards, and a monster-scoring encounter builder that deploys to the canvas.
pitch: Table-side drama for your game: persistent player messaging, lasting injuries, critical and fumble cards, inspiration, room searching and quick encounter building.

features.title: Journal-backed messages
features.text: Party, group and private threads stored in journals so they survive chat wipes; mentions, reactions, markdown, images.

features.title: Lasting injuries
features.text: Hard hits cause damage, conditions, roll penalties and bleeding until treated with a Medicine check.

features.title: Criticals and fumbles
features.text: Authored card decks with damage, conditions, penalties and duration enforced by the Apply button.

features.title: Inspiration cards
features.text: Cards become one-use inventory items players can hold and spend later.

features.title: Room searching
features.text: One roll finds coins and items across five rarity tables and posts a narrated card.

features.title: Quick encounters
features.text: Pick habitat and difficulty, get a party-scored monster list, roll detection, deploy to canvas.

steps: Install and enable Coffee Pub Blacksmith, then Bibliosoph; the Coffee Pub toolbar gets a button per enabled feature.
Test Messages: open Messages, choose the party conversation, type, press Enter.
As GM, select a token, click Injuries to apply one, then Check-Up to view and treat afflictions.
